goal: Assign unique canonical ChIJ Place IDs for each Citi Bike dock station, materialize all dock visits across ride history, and deploy clean database to device

steps.description: Audit, disambiguate, and establish a 100% unique, canonical Google Maps ChIJ Place ID for every physical Citi Bike dock station used in ride history
Reconcile and flank 100% of authentic Citi Bike rides in timeline_viewer.db with 15-second origin and destination dock visits using unique canonical Place IDs, enforcing stay protection
Recompute exact visit counts, first/last timestamps in places table, verifying ~1,200+ visited Citi Bike stations and ~9,000+ total visited places with zero zero-count visited stations
Build clean master odlh-storage.db and places/2 cache with 100% unique dock Place IDs, zero synthetic entries, and zero overlaps
Deploy clean master databases to Pixel 8a, restart GMS/Maps, and capture live on-device verification proofs of Places tab and timeline navigation
